# delta libauth-vs-leanbch: sigChecks +1, hashIters +12, opCost +26768 = 1*26000 + 12*64  (EXACT)
# BCHN agrees with LeanBCH on sigChecks (0). libauth is the outlier.
# ---- CORRECTION + CORROBORATION, 2026-07-21 ----
# The `bchn-consensus` row above is WRONG AS RENDERED. bchn-leg reports 0/0/0 on EVERY reject because
# BCHN's VerifyScript (interpreter.cpp:2677) copies its local `metrics` into the caller's `metricsOut`
# only on success (:2745, :2794) and the leg reads a default-constructed object unconditionally
# (bchn-leg.cpp:315,323-325). 0u4tu8 is a BCHN REJECT, so those zeros are an initializer. The row
# should read `bchn-consensus  reject  -  null  null  -  -  -`.
# The CONCLUSION nevertheless SURVIVES, on a real measurement rather than a default. Re-run through
# conformance/evidence/bchn-partial-probe.cpp (VerifyScript transcribed verbatim, metrics retained on
# the failure path; validated: 5803/5803 verdicts and all 2350 accept-path metrics identical to the
# leg), BCHN's ACTUAL accrual on 0u4tu8 is:
#   bchn-TRUE   reject  -  0  10  -  -  4194     (phase eval_redeem, "Signature must be zero ...")
# LeanBCH matches BCHN on ALL THREE of sigChecks / hashIters / opCost (0 / 10 / 4194) — one of only
# 2 vectors out of 2,386 BCHN rejects where that happens (the other is g8xdap). libauth's 1 / 22 is
# the outlier, because crypto.js:177 bills the sig-check BEFORE the length check at :184 and before
# verifySignatureSchnorr at :187, whereas BCHN tallies at interpreter.cpp:1616, after both.
# Full partition + per-vector data: conformance/evidence/LBCH-2026-001-overbill-partition.tsv.
